text: Quiet. Quiet on the net. They come to a voice.
'Birch', this is 'Don'. Has Moscow's instruction been received? Over.
Fire when ready. The specials: three salvoes, no more. Over.
'Don', this is 'Birch'. The enemy is not answering. The line is empty. Over.
All stations. Our dead... are getting up. This is not panic. I can see them. Over.
This is 'Don'. Cease transmission. Not one word of this on the air. Write: an epidemic among the enemy. Out.
'Birch-three'. The tanks have stopped at the woods. What's ahead of us isn't Germans. Over.
All stations: the Returned are not to come within fifty metres. Hit the wound. The wound, not the head. Over.
How do you read? I repeat: our dead from Second Battalion are walking through our positions. West. Don't fire on our own... cancel that. Fire.
Commissar, no speeches. They don't listen any more.
Flares every five minutes. While we can see, they can't come up on us unseen. Over.
'Don', 'Birch'. The village ahead is burning. We lit it. Our own... we were burning our own. Over.
No burials. Do you hear? Bury no one. Stack them and burn them.
Semyonov, is that you? Semyonov, answer...
They told us: an epidemic among the enemy. The enemy! So who is that walking across the field, Comrade Major?
Four days. Remember it: four days. Whoever was killed yesterday gets up the day after tomorrow.
Over... over... 'Birch', answer. 'Birch'. ...Anyone.
'Pine'. The Germans are trucking away bodies. Ours. By the lorry-load, west. What do they want with our dead? Over.
Repeat for HQ: the Germans are collecting the Returned. Not destroying them. Collecting them. Over.
Violet light in the west. Third night running. What is it, 'Don'? Over.
Laboratory Four is never to be mentioned on the air. Never. That is an order.
They've stopped walking west. They're standing. All of them turned... toward the mountains.
The prisoner says: 'Staub'. Dust. He says they will make dust. I don't understand. Over.
Operator, keep tuning. Up at twelve hundred someone's talking German and laughing. I don't like that laugh.
It's snowing. Violet. Report it? ...How do I report that?
Retreat? Retreat where, when our dead outnumber our living?
Do you believe in God, Misha? ...I didn't either, before.
Volkov is here. Volkov himself, from Moscow. They say he's known about this since 'thirty. Since 'thirty!
Order: in the report, 'an epidemic among the enemy'. Carry it out. Carry it out!
